description: A task type is declared once on this page and consumed everywhere — the rep's form, the task list, Smart Views, automation and the workflow engine all read this single declaration. Configuration is completed top-down: grain, enforcement, fields, then rules.

fields.description: The type name is displayed to reps wherever the activity appears. The grain (vertical · group · program) is chosen first; every downstream picker, permission and workflow offer is scoped by it, and a lead outside the grain is refused this activity at save.
fields.label: Identity & Grain

fields.description: Grain axis. Blank = wildcard (available across that axis). The composite key is vertical::group::program::type_name, so the SAME type_name can carry a different schema per grain.
fields.label: Vertical

fields.description: Everything that may block a bad save is declared here and nowhere else. Visit Mode marks the activity location-eligible when In-Person. Location Required When names the condition under which coordinates are demanded at save. Completes on save closes the task the moment its form is submitted. Disable bulk complete forces every completion through the form, one by one.
fields.label: Enforcement

fields.description: In-Person makes the type location-eligible (Phase B). Blank = not an in-person visit.
fields.label: Visit Mode

fields.description: Optional condition that makes this type location-required conditionally, e.g. meeting_type==Physical Visit. Format <field>==<value> or <field> in v1|v2.
fields.label: Location When

fields.description: On: this type is logged complete on save (an activity). Off: a plain open to-do.
fields.label: Logged Complete

fields.description: On: a task of this type cannot be completed from the list's bulk action — its form must be filled one at a time.
fields.label: Disable Bulk Complete

fields.description: One row is added per question the form asks; row order is form order and rows are reordered by their drag handle. Label is shown to the rep; Fieldname is the stable key every consumer addresses. Fieldtype and Options drive the control and its choices. Source declares whose data is captured — Activity lands on the task's own storage, Lead is read from and written back to the patient record under its own permissions. Section files the answer into a declared storage section and groups it visually; a blank section falls to the answers store. Reqd marks a field always mandatory; conditional mandatory is declared under Rules.
fields.label: Fields

fields.description: Per-type form fields, rendered in order. Empty = the type is a plain task (no activity form).
fields.label: Schema

fields.description: One row declares one reaction of the form. Rule label is a free name used only for reading the grid. The When columns name a field, an operator and a value; a blank When declares the form's opening state. Action is one of Show, Hide or Make Mandatory, applied to every field listed in Targets. Add target appends a picked field to Targets and clears itself. A hidden field is never required and its value is never accepted, so chained rules resolve without ordering.
fields.label: Rules

name: CRM Task Type
